name: Toshio Taro
source:
Kid genius who remembers absolutely everything due to a medical condition called hyperthymesia. He loves technology, and you can tell by the homemade gadget with the LCD screen that he wears on his arm. Being the youngest in the group, he is one to force himself in the shoes of an adult only to fail at it. He invented the "D-phone" which is the radio device tat Durchhalten uses to communicate.

[From [url=http://exogenesisvn.com/characters/]the official website[/url]]
